description: Documentation for processed datasets in the CL Analyst ML pipeline

set_01.name: Base Feature Set
set_01.description: Core technical indicators with normalized prices, volatility measures, and cyclical time encoding. Suitable for classification models predicting significant price moves.

Time_Sin.description: Sine component of cyclical time encoding
Time_Sin.purpose: Captures daily trading cycle patterns (e.g., market open/close effects)

Time_Cos.description: Cosine component of cyclical time encoding
Time_Cos.purpose: Complements Time_Sin to fully encode circular time relationship

MACD_Hist.purpose: Visualizes momentum strength and direction changes

VOL_3D.calculation: Rolling standard deviation of returns over 864 bars (3 days)

VOL_7D.calculation: Rolling standard deviation of returns over 2016 bars (7 days)

VOL_30D.calculation: Rolling standard deviation of returns over 8640 bars (30 days)

Target.purpose: Supervised learning label for price movement prediction

Parkinson_Vol_24H.description: Parkinson volatility estimator using High-Low range
Parkinson_Vol_24H.purpose: More efficient volatility estimate than Close-Close; captures intrabar panic/activity that may not result in net price change

Return_Skew_24H.description: Rolling skewness of 5-minute returns over 24 hours
Return_Skew_24H.purpose: Detects asymmetric return distribution; negative skew indicates crash risk (many small ups, occasional big down)

Return_Kurt_24H.description: Rolling kurtosis of 5-minute returns over 24 hours
Return_Kurt_24H.purpose: Measures tail thickness; high kurtosis indicates elevated probability of extreme moves (shock risk)

SMA_20_Dist.purpose: Shows price position relative to short-term trend

SMA_30d_Dist.calculation: (Close - SMA_30d) / SMA_30d where SMA_30d uses 8640 bars
SMA_30d_Dist.purpose: Shows price position relative to long-term trend

Volume_Log.purpose: Normalized volume that handles spikes and zero values

notes: Approximately 8640 rows are dropped due to NaN from 30-day rolling windows
Target is calculated BEFORE price normalization using absolute prices
If both Buy and Sell conditions are met, the larger move determines the label
Raw return columns (Open_Return, High_Return, Low_Return, Close_Return) are calculated internally but DROPPED from final output
Raw returns are 'noise' for 48-hour predictions - we extract their signal via regime features (Parkinson Vol, Skew, Kurtosis)
